ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: SOS – ExpiryAlert uses the camera to scan documents on-device. Scanned images are deleted and never uploaded.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SOS – ExpiryAlert uses the microphone only when you dictate a document. Audio is processed on-device and never uploaded.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SOS – ExpiryAlert uses on-device speech recognition to fill in document details. Your speech is never uploaded.
